name: Nuptl
tagline: The operating system for high-volume wedding businesses.
positioning: Nuptl unifies inquiries, contracts, and event timelines into one system built for multi-location wedding vendors managing hundreds of couples a season.

hero.h1: Run every wedding on one calm, connected platform.
hero.sub: Nuptl gives enterprise catering groups, venue portfolios, and photography studios a single source of truth for every couple, contract, and timeline — from first inquiry to final invoice.

features.title: Inquiry to booked, no dropped threads
features.description: Route every wedding inquiry to the right coordinator, auto-tag by date and venue, and watch conversion by source across all your locations.

features.title: Contracts that sign themselves
features.description: Send branded proposals with usage-based e-signature, deposit schedules, and automatic reminders when a couple stalls before the deadline.

features.title: Timelines every team can trust
features.description: Build the day-of run sheet once and sync it to catering, floral, and AV crews so nobody chases a Google Doc at 6am.

features.title: Revenue you can forecast
features.description: See booked-versus-available Saturdays, average contract value, and seasonal pacing across the whole portfolio in one board.

features.title: Roles for real org charts
features.description: Give regional managers, coordinators, and finance scoped access with approval chains that match how enterprise vendors actually operate.

features.title: Built to plug into your stack
features.description: Two-way sync with your accounting, email, and floor-plan tools through an API your operations team will actually enjoy using.

testimonials.quote: We manage nine venues and 1,400 weddings a year. Before Nuptl our coordinators lived in spreadsheets and lost deposits. Now every booking has one record and finance closes the month in two days.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Sable

testimonials.quote: The day-of timeline sync alone paid for the platform. Our catering and floral leads finally work from the same run sheet, and day-of confusion basically disappeared.
testimonials.name: Devon Ashcombe

testimonials.quote: Usage-based pricing let us onboard all eleven studios without a painful seat negotiation. We pay for the weddings we actually book, which finance loves.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkataraman

pricing.blurb: For single-location vendors formalizing their booking pipeline.
For multi-venue groups running high season at scale.
For national vendor networks with bespoke compliance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Nuptl is the enterprise CRM for wedding vendors who take every couple seriously. One calm system, from first inquiry to last dance.
